name: herder
description: Shape focused plans, execute them through a deterministic Run Manager, and observe them in a local graph dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify, create, and execute plans with specialized agents.
interface.longDescription: Herder shapes requested changes and verified findings into focused dependency-aware plans, compiles shared context into immutable snapshots, runs parallel per-plan implementation-review loops through a persistent deterministic TypeScript control plane, escalates unresolved findings to an independent Judge, integrates verified work transactionally, stores run and worker-attempt metadata in SQLite, and automatically hosts a read-only local graph dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Grill me one decision at a time, then create a focused validated Herder plan graph for this objective.
Install Herder's bundled role profiles for this host.
Fire the implementation plans in this repository and open its live dashboard.
